name: Taiwan Environment Scientific Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Environment Scientific Co., Ltd., established in 2003 and headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan, specializes in environmental management services. The company's primary focus areas include the assessment and restoration of soil and groundwater, in addition to providing water and wastewater treatment solutions throughout Taiwan. Their comprehensive service offerings encompass crucial aspects of subsurface environmental management, such as groundwater monitoring, the installation of both pumping and injection wells, and detailed soil and groundwater sampling. They possess expertise in the design, fabrication, and deployment of advanced remediation technologies, including soil vapor extraction (SVE), air stripping, in-situ chemical oxidation (ISCO), and electrokinetic (EK) systems. Furthermore, the company undertakes complete remediation site construction, covering mechanical, piping, and system control installations. Their engineering design capabilities extend to specialized solutions like acid washing and chemical injection. They also perform essential well testing and maintenance, which involves pump performance tests, video inspections, and precise flow and velocity measurements. A key service also includes the installation and verification of leak detection systems for gas station tanks and associated pipelines. Beyond these core environmental remediation and treatment services, Taiwan Environment Scientific Co., Ltd. provides solutions for sludge processing, air pollution control, integrated environmental system and outsourcing services, and assists clients with critical environmental license applications and permitting.
